actions.generateGamma.description: Create a new Gamma generation job.

JSON object for card attributes (e.g., dimensions).
actions.generateGamma.props.cardSplit.de: How your content will be divided into cards. Use '---' in text for breaks.
actions.generateGamma.props.exportAs.des: Additional file types for saving your gamma.
actions.generateGamma.props.folderId.des: The folder to save the generated gamma into.
actions.generateGamma.props.format.descr: The type of artifact you want to create.
actions.generateGamma.props.imageOptions: JSON object for image attributes (e.g., source, model, style).
actions.generateGamma.props.inputText.de: Text used to generate your gamma (1-400,000 characters).
actions.generateGamma.props.numCards.des: How many cards to create (default 10). Pro: 1-50, Ultra: 1-75.
actions.generateGamma.props.sharingOptio: JSON object for sharing attributes (e.g., workspaceAccess, externalAccess).
actions.generateGamma.props.textMode.des: How you want your inputText to be modified.
JSON object for text attributes (e.g., amount, tone, audience, language).
actions.generateGamma.props.themeName.de: The theme from Gamma to be used. Defaults to workspace default.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to get your Gamma API Key:

1.  Log in to your Gamma account. You must have a **Pro or Ultra plan** to access the API.
2.  Navigate to **Settings & Members** (click your workspace name in the top-left).
3.  Go to the **API Key** tab.
4.  Click **Create API key** and give it a name (e.g., "Activepieces").
5.  Copy the key (it starts with `sk-gamma-`) and paste it below.

**Direct Link to API Settings:** [**https://gamma.app/settings/api**](https://gamma.app/settings/api)
description: An AI-powered design partner that helps users generate presentations, documents, social media posts, cards, etc., via natural language.
